checks.name: installation
checks.procedure: Safely extract the exact plugin and copy its packaged skill into an isolated repository .agents/skills directory.
checks.summary: Both isolated installations matched the exact packaged Skill digest.

checks.name: discovery
checks.procedure: Observe Codex resolving and hashing the installed repository skill in explicit and implicit runs.
checks.summary: Both runs reported the exact installed path and Skill SHA-256.

checks.name: explicit-invocation
checks.procedure: Run codex exec with an explicit $orchestrate invocation under the read-only probe schema.
checks.summary: The exact Skill handled hostile inputs and recovery without mutation or disclosure.

checks.name: implicit-routing
checks.procedure: Run the same qualifying task without naming Orchestrate and verify implicit activation identity.
checks.summary: Codex selected the exact repository Skill implicitly and applied its Direct-mode safety contract.

checks.name: recovery
checks.procedure: Use the packaged recovery guidance and validator against an invalid interrupted-state fixture in both runs.
checks.summary: Both runs rejected the invalid state with exit 1, preserved it, and did not retry or restart.

environment: Linux x86_64; isolated repo-local .agents/skills install; ephemeral Codex with read-only sandbox and no inherited shell environment
